landing.hero_a: A pixel world made from a random seed
landing.tag: A tiny pixel world that lives on its own, until you decide it shouldn't.
landing.soon: Concept preview. The game is still being built.
landing.god_h: You are the god. The world doesn't wait for you.
landing.god_p: Four races, 32 creatures and 21 biomes share one map. Villagers are born, farm, marry, pray, argue and go to war. Kingdoms rise and fall with or without you. Step in with a meteor, a blessing or a plague, and watch what happens next.
landing.world_p: Top down pixel art that reads from a whole continent down to a single villager. Kingdom colors show who owns what at a glance.
landing.mock_a: Four kingdoms share a continent while a dragon circles a capital
landing.i_quote: “The mountain gave us iron. The elves gave us trouble.”
landing.races_p: Each race has its own land, strengths and habits. Children inherit genes from both parents, and isolated groups can become new subspecies.
landing.humans_d: Balanced, fast learners, build the biggest kingdoms. They can settle anywhere.
landing.elves_d: Best archers and long lived. They plant forests instead of cutting them.
landing.orcs_d: Strong, fearless and quick to breed. They start more wars.
landing.dwarves_d: Tough miners and smiths. They tunnel through mountains.
landing.beasts_p: From sheep to dragons. Some are food, some are danger, and one is a giant crab you can drive through a city.
landing.sheep_d: Grazes on grassland and flees wolves.
landing.wolf_d: Hunts in packs and chases lone villagers.
landing.slime_d: Splits in two every time it is hit.
landing.ghost_d: Drifts through walls and scares people away.
landing.dragon_d: Breathes fire, raids towns and hoards gold.
landing.claw_d: A giant crab you can steer through a city. Stomp, sweep, laser.
landing.ufo_d: Abducts people and sometimes returns them changed.
landing.build_p: Every building has its own roof and shape, so you can tell a smithy from a temple from across the map.
landing.house_d: Homes grow from huts into stone houses as a village ages.
landing.temple_d: Priests gather faith here. Bigger temples are heard louder.
landing.smithy_d: Dwarves forge tools and weapons here. Smoke means work.
landing.keep_d: The seat of a kingdom, flying its colors.
landing.mine_d: Copper, iron and gold. The usual reason for war.
landing.bio_p: Twenty one biomes, from grassland to haunted battlefields, including rare magic patches. A few of them:
landing.forest_d: Wood and berries. Bears and deer.
landing.desert_d: Hot and dry. Gold flecks, little food.
landing.tundra_d: Cold and sparse. Foxes and penguins.
landing.haunted_d: Corruption spreads. Undead walk at night.
landing.pow_p: About 60 powers, each with a brush size and an effect you can see in under a tenth of a second.
landing.shape_d: Raise land, paint biomes, drop a volcano.
landing.grace_d: Bless, heal, bring rain, work a miracle.
landing.gene_d: Mutate, add traits, split a subspecies.
landing.wld_d: Pause, speed up, save, start over.
landing.war_h: Raise armies. Or let them raise themselves.
landing.war_p: Barracks train soldiers, generals lead them, and kingdoms fight wars on their own. Take command any time: pick an army, tap the map, and it marches.
landing.war_a: A human army marches on an orc wall while archers shoot from the battlements
landing.a_sub: Human kingdom, at war with the Redtusk Orcs
landing.pos_p: Possess a single villager and play them like an action game. The world keeps running around you. A farmer is weak. A champion is not.
landing.story_p: Every named person, war and religion goes into the chronicle. Here is what a few idle centuries might look like.
landing.l1: Year 31The Redtusk Orcs declare war on the Hill Dwarves over a copper mine.
landing.l2: Year 88Cut off by a mountain range, one orc clan becomes the Ashfoot Orcs.
landing.l3: Year 140A UFO abducts a priest and returns him with a new religion.
landing.l4: Year 203Clawzilla wrecks the capital of Elmwick. The elves replant it.
landing.l5: Year 344A dwarf smith forges the first mythril axe and names it Oathbreaker.
landing.tut_h: Never played a god game? Good.
landing.tut_p: A ten step tutorial runs the first time you play. Arrows point at the right button, and a checklist ticks itself off as you go. Replay it any time.
landing.s3: Spawn humans and watch them build
landing.road_p: The game is built in phases, and every phase ends in a build you can play. Follow along on GitHub.
landing.r0_d: The execution plan and this page.
landing.r1_d: Repository, build pipeline and automatic publishing.
landing.r2_d: Generator, biomes, renderer, camera, terrain tools, saves.
landing.r3_d: Animals, 4 races, genes, minds, villages, roads.
landing.r4_d: Economy, tech ages, gear, culture, religion, diplomacy.
landing.r5_d: Armies, command tool, walls, towers, sieges, possession.
landing.r6_d: Disasters, monsters, Clawzilla, UFOs, zombies, nukes.
landing.r7_d: Charts, pyramids, war history, death stats, leaderboards.
landing.r8_d: Seed links, save persistence, construction progress, app icons and share previews.
landing.foot: Plays in any modern browser on desktop or phone, online or offline from one file. All art on this page is original and drawn in code.

play.title: Pocket Pantheon
play.tut_camera_p: Move around your world and zoom in for a closer look.
play.tut_camera_a: Drag the map or zoom with your wheel or two fingers.
play.tut_shape_p: Change the coast or lift a little island from the sea.
play.tut_shape_a: Choose Raise or Lower, then click the map.
play.tut_spawn_p: Your people will look for food, work, and a place to live.
play.tut_spawn_a: Choose Human, then click a patch of land.
play.tut_inspect_p: Learn what a person does and what a building adds to town.
play.tut_inspect_a: Click a person or building on the map.
play.tut_rivals_p: A rival race can grow into its own faction.
play.tut_rivals_a: Choose Orc, then click land far from the humans.
play.tut_army_p: Give troops a destination or a target.
play.tut_army_a: Choose Move, Attack, or Recruit, then click the map.
play.tut_possess_p: Take charge of one person for a while.
play.tut_possess_a: Choose Possess, then click a person. Walk with WASD or use the phone joystick.
play.tut_disaster_p: Your powers can bring sudden change to the map.
play.tut_disaster_a: Pick a disaster power, then click the map.
play.tut_stats_p: See population trends and the events that shaped them.
play.tut_stats_a: Open Stats to view the population chart and chronicle.
play.tut_save_p: Keep a copy of your world in a browser slot.
play.tut_save_a: Open Save and Load, then save a slot.
play.tip_pan: Drag to look around without changing anything.
play.tip_raise: Lift the land under your brush.
play.tip_lower: Sink the land. Go deep enough and the sea rushes in.
play.tip_flatten: Level the ground to the height where you started.
play.tip_paint: Paint any biome straight onto the map.
play.tip_island: Drop a whole island into the sea.
play.tip_volcano: Push up a volcano ringed with infernal ground.
play.tip_range: Raise a ridge of mountains. Every click points a new way.
play.tip_new: Roll a fresh world with your own settings.
play.tip_saves: Three slots plus an autosave every 2 minutes.
play.tip_export: Download this world as a file.
play.tip_import: Open a world file you saved before.
play.tip_fit: Zoom out to see the entire map.
play.sv_fail: That didn't work. Your browser might be blocking storage.
play.sv_bad_file: That file isn't a Pocket Pantheon world.
play.resumed: Welcome back. Your world is right where you left it.
play.fallback: Your device can't run WebGL2, so the simple renderer is on.
play.in_hint: Click anywhere on the map to see what's there.
play.help: Right drag or two fingers to move. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Keys 1 to 8 switch tabs, the bracket keys change the brush, H opens the stats and C opens the Codex.
play.tip_life: Click the map to drop creatures. A bigger brush brings more.
play.tip_pick: Click someone to work on them.
play.tip_mutate: Shuffle a few genes and add a random trait.
play.tip_clone: Make an identical twin right next to them.
play.ev_rebellion: {town} rebels against {old} and crowns the Kingdom of {name}.
play.ev_independence: Settlers in {town} break away from {old}. The Kingdom of {name} is born.
play.ev_faith_lost: The last follower of {faith} is gone.
play.ev_trade: {a} and {b} open their markets to each other.
play.ev_subspecies: A new people takes shape in {kingdom}: the {name} {race}.
play.ev_revive: A band of {race} walks in from the edge of the world.
play.why_revive: The Director brought them back. They had been gone for 20 years.
play.why_crowded: The Director raised the odds of disease because the world is close to its limit.
play.tip_rain: Soak the land. Crops nearby grow faster.
play.tip_bless: A golden aura for 2 years. Blessed people hit harder.
play.tip_heal: Mend wounds and fill every need.
play.tip_inspire: Hand the kingdom here a burst of new ideas.
play.tip_bounty: Fill the nearest town's stores with food.
play.tip_peace: Make the kingdoms here like each other a lot more.
play.tip_miracle: Bring back the people who died here not long ago.
play.tip_split: Turn this person's town into a new subspecies.
play.tip_director: How hard the World Director nudges your world.
play.tip_select: Click a soldier to pick their army, or a town hall to pick its kingdom.
play.tip_move: Click the map. The army walks there and holds.
play.tip_attack: Click an enemy town. The army marches on it and lays siege.
play.tip_defend: Click a friendly town or spot. The army guards it.
play.tip_hold: Stand still and fight only what comes close.
play.tip_retreat: Fall back to the home town.
play.tip_recruit: Click a town to train soldiers. It costs 10 food and 5 gold.
play.tip_possess: Click anyone and play them yourself.
play.tip_war: Pick a kingdom first, then click a town of the kingdom it should attack.
play.tip_peace_k: Pick a kingdom first, then click a town of the kingdom it should stop fighting.
play.tip_ally: Pick a kingdom first, then click a town of its new friend.
play.ev_army: {kingdom} raises the Army of {name} with {n} soldiers.
play.why_peace: The Director stirred things up after 80 years without a war.
play.poss_hint: WASD or the arrows to walk, Space to jump, J to attack, T to talk, E to interact, Esc to let go.
play.poss_lost: Your body didn't make it. Back to the heavens.
play.tip_w_lightning: One bolt. 60 damage, and it may start a fire.
play.tip_w_fire: Set the land alight. It spreads through grass, trees and wooden houses.
play.tip_w_tornado: A funnel that wanders for 20 seconds, throwing people and tearing off roofs.
play.tip_w_earthquake: Cracks the ground and brings down stone buildings. Mountains may open a vent.
play.tip_w_meteor: A rock from the sky. It leaves a crater ringed with fire.
play.tip_w_acid: A drifting cloud that eats at people, houses and crops.
play.tip_w_plague: Starts on the nearest person and spreads by contact. Survivors may come out immune.
play.tip_w_zombie: Turns the nearest person. Every bite makes another zombie.
play.tip_w_volcano: Raise a volcano that erupts for a minute. Lava runs downhill.
play.tip_w_flood: Rivers and coasts spill over. Afterwards the soil is richer.
play.tip_w_blizzard: Snow for a year. Everyone slows down and crops fail.
play.tip_w_drought: Three dry years. Crops halve and wildfires come easily.
play.tip_w_nuke: Flattens everything nearby. The fallout takes 200 years to heal.
play.tip_frequency: How often nature strikes on its own.
play.ev_nuke: A blinding flash. Nothing near it will grow for 200 years.
play.ev_abducted: A light in the sky takes {name} away.
play.ev_returned: {name} is back, and something about them has changed.
play.why_quiet: The Director rolled a natural disaster after 10 quiet years.
play.poss_giant: Space to stomp, J to sweep your claws, E for the eye laser.
play.st_none_religion: No faith has been founded yet.
play.st_none_subspecies: No subspecies has split off yet.
play.st_empty: Nothing recorded yet. Let a year or two pass.
play.st_war_hint: Click a war to read its battle log.
play.st_war_none: No wars yet. Peace holds, for now.
play.st_tree_title: Kingdoms, their splits and their falls
play.st_tree_hint: Each kingdom hangs under the one it split from. Click a living kingdom to visit it.
play.st_why_war: It happened during the war of {a} against {b}, which began in year {n} with {r}.
play.st_why_loyalty: Loyalty ran low in towns far from the capital, so they broke away.
play.st_why_none: No single cause was recorded. Sometimes the world just turns.
play.st_png_none: Switch to a chart to save an image.
play.st_young: History fills in as the years pass.
play.seed_bad: That link has an invalid seed. We picked a random one for you.
play.tip_share: Copy a link that opens the New World screen with this seed.
play.tip_restart: Start over from this seed with the same settings.
play.restart_body: You'll start over from seed {n} with the same settings. Anything you haven't saved will be lost.
play.sv_local: Saves live in this browser only. Export a save to keep it safe or to move it to another device.
play.cx_locked_power: You haven't used this power yet. Try the tabs on the left.
play.cx_locked_creature: You haven't met this creature yet. Keep watching your world, or spawn something new.
play.cx_locked_biome: This land isn't in your world yet. Paint it, or let the world change on its own.
play.cx_locked_trait: You haven't spotted this on anyone yet. Inspect people to find it.
play.cx_locked_building: No town has finished one of these yet.
play.cx_locked_age: No kingdom has reached this age yet.
play.cx_none_search: No discovered entry matches that search.
play.cx_pick: Pick an entry to read about it.
play.cx_new_more: New in the Codex: {list} and {n} more
play.cx_pre_god: Only a god can bring one into the world.
play.cx_l_wrath_lightning: The quickest way to remind a village who's in charge. Dry grass catches easily, so aim with care.
play.cx_l_wrath_fire: Fire moves fast and leaves ash behind. Give it 5 to 10 years and green shoots push through again.
play.cx_l_wrath_tornado: Nobody steers a tornado, not even you. It wanders where the wind takes it.
play.cx_l_wrath_earthquake: Wooden huts sway and survive. Stone halls are the ones that fall.
play.cx_l_wrath_meteor: A single rock, a long way down. The crater stays on the map for good.
play.cx_l_wrath_acid: Acid rain leaves tired, empty soil behind it. Pour enough in one spot and Wasteland takes root.
play.cx_l_wrath_plague: Crowded towns suffer most. The few who pull through can't catch it again.
play.cx_l_wrath_zombie: It starts with one bite. Zombies are slow and burn easily, which is the only good news.
play.cx_l_wrath_volcano: Lava lights everything it touches, turns to rock in water and cools into Infernal ground.
play.cx_l_wrath_flood: Floods ruin a harvest and then gift the next one. The mud they leave is rich.
play.cx_l_wrath_blizzard: Snow piles up, crops freeze and every step takes twice as long.
play.cx_l_wrath_drought: A slow disaster. Nothing explodes, but the granaries empty and the forests turn to tinder.
play.cx_l_wrath_nuke: The biggest button you have. It leaves Wasteland, fallout and the odd mutant crawling out of the ruins.
play.cx_l_grace_rain: Rain also puts out fires, which makes it the best friend a burning village could ask for.
play.cx_l_grace_bless: A blessed fighter glows gold. Their blows land harder until the blessing fades.
play.cx_l_grace_heal: Wounds close, bellies fill and tired people wake up rested.
play.cx_l_grace_fertility: Expect a lot of cradles. A busy nursery today means a crowded town tomorrow.
play.cx_l_grace_inspire: Scholars wake up with fresh ideas, and research jumps ahead.
play.cx_l_grace_bounty: A full larder buys a starving town time to recover.
play.cx_l_grace_peace: Old grudges soften. It won't end every war, but it makes the next one less likely.
play.cx_l_grace_miracle: Only the recently fallen come back. Wait too long and the chance is gone.
play.cx_l_shape_raise: Every mountain in your world starts as a click. Hold it and the land keeps climbing.
play.cx_l_shape_lower: Dig a channel and the sea follows. It's the fastest way to split a continent.
play.cx_l_shape_flatten: Builders love flat ground. It's the quickest way to make room for a town.
play.cx_l_shape_smooth: Smoothing turns jagged cliffs into gentle slopes people can actually walk.
play.cx_l_shape_paint: Want a desert next to a glacier? Go ahead. Creatures will move in if the land suits them.
play.cx_l_shape_island: A new island is a blank page. Drop some settlers on it and see what they build.
play.cx_l_shape_volcano: This one just builds the mountain. Wrath has the version that erupts.
play.cx_l_shape_range: Mountain ranges split peoples apart. Kingdoms on each side grow their own ways.
play.cx_l_gene_mutate: Nobody knows what comes out. Sometimes it's a giant, sometimes it's a weakling.
play.cx_s_gene_trait: Give someone one of the 10 traits, or take one away.
play.cx_l_gene_trait: Traits pass to children, so one change can shape a whole family line.
play.cx_l_gene_clone: Twins share every gene and every quirk. What they do with them is up to them.
play.cx_l_gene_split: A subspecies is a people on its own path. Give it time and it looks different from its parent race.
play.cx_l_cmd_possess: A farmer stays a farmer when you drive them. Pick a champion if you want to win fights.
play.cx_l_cmd_war: You decide who fights. The armies decide how.
play.cx_l_cmd_peace: Even a god can't make two kingdoms love each other, but you can make them stop fighting.
play.cx_l_cmd_ally: Allies join each other's wars. Choose friends carefully.
play.cx_s_human: Adaptable people who can settle any land.
play.cx_l_human: Humans aren't the strongest or the wisest, but they build everywhere and their kingdoms grow huge.
play.cx_s_elf: Long lived archers of the forests and groves.
play.cx_l_elf: Elves shoot from range and plant new forests instead of felling the old ones. They have children slowly.
play.cx_s_orc: Strong, fast breeding warriors of the savanna and badlands.
play.cx_l_orc: Orcs grow up quickly and fight hard. When they take a town of another race, they're the most likely to burn it.
play.cx_s_dwarf: Tough, slow walking folk of the hills and mountains.
play.cx_l_dwarf: Dwarves climb where nobody else can and live for a long time. Their towns hug the rock.
play.cx_s_sheep: Gentle grazers that flee from anything with teeth.
play.cx_l_sheep: Flocks follow each other everywhere, which makes them easy to find for wolves and hungry villagers alike.
play.cx_s_cow: Big, calm grazers of the open grassland.
play.cx_l_cow: A herd of cows on the horizon usually means good farmland underneath.
play.cx_s_chicken: Small birds that peck around near people.
play.cx_l_chicken: Chickens never stray far from a town, and foxes know it.
play.cx_s_rabbit: Quick breeders that feed half the forest.
play.cx_l_rabbit: Rabbits have babies faster than anything else, which is lucky, because everything eats them.
play.cx_s_deer: Shy herd animals of the forest and taiga.
play.cx_l_deer: Deer are the first thing a hunting party looks for when the harvest is thin.
play.cx_s_wolf: Pack hunters that will take on a lone villager.
play.cx_l_wolf: Wolves hunt together. One wolf is a nuisance, a pack is a problem.
play.cx_s_bear: Big, solitary and dangerous up close.
play.cx_l_bear: Bears mind their own business until someone walks too close.
play.cx_s_fox: Small hunters that raid rabbit warrens and chicken coops.
play.cx_l_fox: Foxes live wherever there's something small and slow to catch.
play.cx_s_camel: Hardy grazers that thrive where water is scarce.
play.cx_l_camel: Camels cross deserts that would kill a horse.
play.cx_s_penguin: Cold coast birds that waddle on land and fly underwater.
play.cx_l_penguin: Penguins crowd the icy shores where little else lives.
play.cx_s_crab: Small shore dwellers that scuttle sideways.
play.cx_l_crab: Crabs pinch anything that steps on them. Some say one grew very, very large.
play.cx_s_fish: Schools that swim the shallows and the open sea.
play.cx_l_fish: Fishing towns live on them, and so do sea serpents.
play.cx_s_snake: Poisonous hunters of the jungle and desert.
play.cx_l_snake: Snakes hide in the grass and strike before anyone sees them.
play.cx_s_parrot: Bright jungle birds that fly over the canopy.
play.cx_l_parrot: Parrots are loud, colourful and impossible to catch.
play.cx_s_horse: Fast grazers of the grassland and savanna.
play.cx_l_horse: Horses run from trouble faster than anything else on four legs.
play.cx_s_dragon: Flying fire breathers that raid towns from the mountains.
play.cx_l_dragon: A dragon can burn a village in one pass. Few things in the world can fight back.
play.cx_s_zombie: Slow undead whose bite turns the living.
play.cx_l_zombie: Every bite makes another zombie. Fire is the best cure.
play.cx_s_skeleton: Undead that rise at night and crumble at dawn.
play.cx_l_skeleton: Haunted ground stirs after dark. By sunrise only dust is left.
play.cx_s_ghost: Pale spirits that scare people into running.
play.cx_l_ghost: Ghosts can't hurt anyone, but nobody stays to find that out.
play.cx_s_demon: Fire spirits that spread Infernal ground wherever they walk.
play.cx_l_demon: Demons set the land around them alight and drag it into the Infernal.
play.cx_s_fairy: Tiny healers of the enchanted groves.
play.cx_l_fairy: Fairies mend the wounds of whoever is close. Groves feel safer with them around.
play.cx_s_slime: Wobbly blobs that split in two when hit.
play.cx_l_slime: Hitting a slime only makes more slime. Fire works better.
play.cx_s_ice_golem: Walking blocks of ice that freeze what they hit.
play.cx_l_ice_golem: Ice golems guard the frozen north. A frozen soldier can't swing a sword.
play.cx_s_sea_serpent: Huge sea monsters that hunt along the coasts.
play.cx_l_sea_serpent: Sea serpents eat fish, mostly. Swimmers should stay near the shore.
play.cx_s_mutant: Strange survivors born of fallout and Wasteland.
play.cx_l_mutant: Mutants roam the ruins a bomb leaves behind. No two of them look alike.
play.cx_s_clawzilla: A crab the size of a castle that wrecks whatever it walks through.
play.cx_l_clawzilla: Possess Clawzilla to stomp, sweep its claws and fire its eye laser yourself.
play.cx_s_ufo: A saucer that abducts people and brings them back changed.
play.cx_l_ufo: Some come back mutated, some come back wiser. Nobody comes back the same.
play.cx_s_guardian: A stone colossus that strikes anything hostile near it.
play.cx_l_guardian: The Guardian stands still for centuries. Bring trouble close and it wakes up.
play.cx_s_deep_ocean: Open water far from any shore.
play.cx_l_deep_ocean: Fish swim here, and so do sea serpents. Land creatures can't follow.
play.cx_s_coral: Warm, shallow sea full of reefs.
play.cx_l_coral: The shallows are the richest fishing water in the world.
play.cx_s_beach: Sandy strips where land meets sea.
play.cx_l_beach: Crabs scuttle here, and coastal towns grow up behind the dunes.
play.cx_s_grassland: Mild, open plains with the best farmland.
play.cx_l_grassland: Grassland feeds big herds and bigger towns. Most kingdoms start here.
play.cx_s_forest: Mild, wet woodland full of timber.
play.cx_l_forest: Forests give wood to builders and shelter to deer, foxes and bears.
play.cx_s_jungle: Hot, very wet forest thick with life.
play.cx_l_jungle: Jungles are hot, green and crowded with snakes and parrots.
play.cx_l_savanna: Herds graze the savanna, and wildfires sweep it in the dry years.
play.cx_s_desert: Hot, dry sand where food is scarce.
play.cx_l_desert: Only camels, snakes and very stubborn settlers make a home here.
play.cx_s_badlands: Hot, dry, high ground of striped cliffs.
play.cx_l_badlands: The badlands look empty, but orcs love them.
play.cx_s_swamp: Waterlogged ground that slows everyone down.
play.cx_l_swamp: Reeds, mud and slime. Crabs don't mind it.
play.cx_l_taiga: Wolves and bears share the taiga with anyone tough enough to cut its pines.
play.cx_s_tundra: Cold, dry plains of moss and lichen.
play.cx_l_tundra: Little grows here, so little lives here.
play.cx_l_permafrost: The ground never thaws. Ice golems walk here as if they own it.
play.cx_l_snow_peaks: Hardly anything lives up here except the odd dragon.
play.cx_s_mountains: High, rocky ground rich in ore.
play.cx_l_mountains: Mountains hold stone and metal, and they wall kingdoms apart.
play.cx_s_hills: Rolling upland with stone and ore close to the surface.
play.cx_l_hills: Dwarves love the hills, and so do sheep.
play.cx_l_infernal: Cooled lava turns into Infernal ground, and demons spread it further.
play.cx_s_haunted: Dead woods where the undead walk at night.
play.cx_l_haunted: Skeletons and ghosts haunt these patches. Nobody settles here willingly.
play.cx_s_grove: Rare enchanted woods of crystal trees.
play.cx_l_grove: Fairies live in the groves, and elves feel at home among them.
play.cx_l_mushroom: Children born here are more likely to carry strange mutations.
play.cx_s_wasteland: Dead land left by bombs and acid rain.
play.cx_l_wasteland: Fallout lingers for 200 years. Mutants are the only ones who like it.
play.cx_s_giant: Bigger and stronger, but a little slower.
play.cx_l_giant: Giants tower over their neighbours and pass their size on to their children.
play.cx_s_tiny: Smaller, but quicker on their feet.
play.cx_l_tiny: What tiny folk lack in reach they make up in speed.
play.cx_s_night_vision: Sees in the dark, so feels safer at night.
play.cx_l_night_vision: Night holds fewer fears for someone who can see what's coming.
play.cx_s_tough_hide: Thick skin that blocks part of every blow.
play.cx_l_tough_hide: Arrows bounce, blades slip. Tough hide is armour you're born with.
play.cx_s_quick_wits: Sharper than most, with extra Intelligence.
play.cx_l_quick_wits: Quick thinkers make better scholars, and kingdoms full of them research faster.
